..Title
Resolution to Approve a Grant Agreement Between the City of Ann Arbor and Community Mental Health Partnership of Southeast Michigan
..Memorandum
Attached for consideration is a resolution authorizing execution of a Grant Agreement Between the City of Ann Arbor and Community Mental Health Partnership of Southeast Michigan.  

On December 16, 2024 City Council approved Resolution R-24-449 which allocated $1,000,000.00 in funding for negative or debilitating impacts at the local level due to the change in the federal government administration. City Council authorized $300,000.00 of that funding for Ann Arbor based support of substance use disorder (SUD) and Intervention via Resolution R-25-166 on May 19, 2025.  The proposed Grant Agreement seeks to grant Community Health Partnership of Southeast Michigan (CMHPSM) the amount of $300,000.00 ("Grant Funds").

The proposed grant agreement incorporates requirements of Resolution R-25-166 including the requirement to ensure the effective implementation and monitoring of funded programs and reporting to detail specific outcomes and metrics of funded programs. City Administration and Community Health Partnership of Southeast Michigan will collaborate to provide an annual report to City Council. 
..Staff
Prepared by:		Marti Praschan, Chief Financial Officer 
Reviewed by:		Michelle Landis, Senior Assistant City Attorney
Approved by:		Milton Dohoney Jr., City Administrator
..Body
Whereas, Resolution R-24-449 allocated $1,000,000.00 in funding for negative or debilitating impacts at the local level due to the change in the federal government administration;   

Whereas, Resolution R-25-166 authorized $300,000.00 of that funding for Ann Arbor based support of substance use disorder (SUD) and Intervention; and 

Whereas, The proposed Grant Agreement grants $300,000.00 to Community Mental Health Partnership of Southeast Michigan to support local substance use service providers to respond to federal funding cuts, to ensure services remain available; 

RESOLVED, That the City Council approve the Grant Agreement Between the City of Ann Arbor and Community Mental Health Partnership of Southeast Michigan granting $300,000 to CMHPSM ("Grand Agreement");

RESOLVED, That the Mayor and City Clerk be authorized and directed to execute the Grant Agreement, consistent with this resolution, subject to approval as to substance by the City Administrator and approval as to form by the City Attorney; and

RESOLVED, That the City Administrator be authorized to take any necessary action to implement this resolution.
